{{Quote|They took the droids, the harvesters. And when that wasn't enough... they took slaves. My daughter, every woman here, my neighbors' wives and kids. The pirates carried them off like livestock!|Danbar Hue|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Danbar Hue''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He owned a [[Chuaro Farmstead|moisture farm]] in the [[Jundland]] area of Tatooine. During the war, he and his neighbors' [[Marriage/Legends|wives]] and [[Parent/Legends|daughters]] were captured by the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and taken to be sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. Hue begged Republic-aligned individuals to help recover the women, which the individuals did by attacking the [[Twin Sun pirates base]].<ref name="TOR" />
